annotations.title: Home loan: rates, borrowing capacity, payments

description: France's home-loan rates this month (L'Observatoire Crédit Logement/CSA, per 15, 20 and 25 years, excluding insurance) and, as asked: what a household can borrow (income_monthly: payments, insurance included, at most 35 % of net income less its other loans, the HCSF rule), and the budget it buys with its down payment once the purchase costs are paid; what a price costs a month over each length, the income it needs at 35 % and the debt ratio it makes; a rate a bank offered (offered_rate, offered_years) against the market's for that length, and what the difference costs over the loan. Purchase costs: notary, guarantee and fees, 8 % of the price for a resale, 3 % for a new home (new_build), unless purchase_costs is given. Insurance: 0.30 % of the loan a year unless insurance_rate says otherwise.

debts_monthly.description: Monthly payments of the household's other loans (car, consumer), in euros; default 0.

down_payment.description: Cash put in (apport), in euros; default 0.

income_monthly.description: The household's net monthly income (before income tax), in euros.

insurance_rate.description: Borrower insurance a year as a share of the loan (0.003 for 0.30 %).

new_build.description: A new home (VEFA): reduced notary fees.

offered_rate.description: A rate a bank offered, excluding insurance (0.039 or 3.9 for 3.90 %).

offered_years.description: The length of the offered loan in years (default 25).

price.description: A price to finance, in euros.

purchase_costs.description: Purchase costs as a share of the price (0.08 for 8 %), instead of the default.
